description: Allowlist for the en-reference preservation gate (src/multilingual/en-reference-preservation.test.ts). Each key is a corpus unit (a plain row id, or <id>#<n> for the n-th `_` body of a markup row) whose English re-render — render(parse_en(src), "en") — drops or changes content, so all 23 translations inherit the loss. A new lossy unit, a changed render of a listed unit, and a listed unit that now passes all fail the gate. Shrinks only: deleting an entry is how a fix is completed. Regenerate with tools/regen-en-reference-baseline.ts.

async-block.family: BY DESIGN — the multilingual front-end strips `async` (engine-NULL row; core deleted `async` in #1102)
async-block.rendered: on click fetch "/api/data" then put it into me

behavior-draggable.family: BENIGN — `init`'s optional `end` written out (the source's one `end` closes the one-line `if`, and `init` ends at the next feature). Upstream requires a block's `end` before a new feature but not a feature's own, so an equivalence needs block depth
behavior-draggable.rendered:
behavior Draggable(dragHandle)
  init
    if no dragHandle set dragHandle to me end
  end
  on pointerdown(clientX, clientY) from dragHandle halt the event then trigger draggable:start then measure x then set startX to it then measure y then set startY to it then set xoff to clientX - startX then set yoff to clientY - startY then repeat until event pointerup from document wait for pointermove(clientX, clientY) or pointerup(clientX, clientY) from document then add { left : $ { clientX - xoff } px ; top : $ { clientY - yoff } px ; } then trigger draggable:move end then trigger draggable:end
  end
end

event-debounce.family: TRIAGE — naked `${…}` URL rendered quoted (does the interpolation survive?)
event-debounce.rendered: on input debounced at 300ms fetch "/api/search?q=${my value}" as json then put it into #results

event-once.family: TRIAGE — source `on click once` is invalid on BOTH engines; render emits `click.once`
event-once.rendered: on click.once add .initialized to me then call setup()

fetch-do-not-throw.rendered: on click fetch "/api/users" as JSON then if it set $users to it end

stagger-animation.rendered: on load repeat for item in .item add .visible to item then wait 100ms end
